Detected, not typed. Each CLI's plan is read from one field, never a token: Claude Code ~/.on → oauthAccount.organizationRateLimitTier (default_claude_max_20x → Max 20x) with billingType (stripe_subscription); no oauthAccount means an API key. Codex ~/.codex/on → auth_mode only (chatgpt or apikey; the file's tokens are not read), and the plan from its newest session log, ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl → payload.rate_limits.plan_type (plus, pro).
